senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. With an indicatory इ। यघि (अंघति.)
1 To go.
2 To go swiftly.
3 To begin moving.
4 To begin.
5 To blame or censure.
r. 10th cl. (अघयति)
To sin, to commit sin.

n. (-घं)
1 Sin.
2 Pain.
3 Passion.
m. (-घः)
Name of a demon; the general of KAṂSA.
E.
अघ to go, and अच् affix, removed by charity, &c.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Purifying, freeing from sin.
E.
अघ, and नाशक what destroys.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Purifying, freeing from sin.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of VIṢṆU.
2 An expiator.
E.
अघ and नाशन destroyer.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Sinful, identical with or fruitful in sin.
E.
अघ and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
An expiatory prayer: reciting mentally a particular passage from the Vedas, while a little water, in the palm of the right hand, is held to the nose; this forms a part of the daily ceremonies of the Brahmans.
m. (-णः)
The author of the passage recited upon the above occasion.
E.
अघ sin, and मृष to bear with, or to sprinkle, युच aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मा-र्म्मं)
Cool, not warm.
E.
अ neg. घर्म्म hot.

m. (-मा)
The moon, as the source of coolness.
E.
अघर्म्म cool, धामन् vesture.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wicked, vicious, sinful.
E.
अघ sin, मतुप् aff.

n. (-हः)
Time or day of impurity, consequent on the death of a relative, &c.
E.
अघ and अहन् day.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree, (the red sort of Achyranthes.)
2 A rubber, what effects friction.
E.
आङ् before घदृ and वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Friction, rubbing, contact.
2 Shaking.
E.
आङ् before घदृ to move, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Touched, rubbed.
2 Shaken.
E.
आङ् before घदृ to move, affix क्त.

m. (-र्षः)
Rubbing, friction.
E.
आङ् before घृष to rub, affix घञ्.

n. (-णं)
Rubbing, friction.
f. (-णी)
A brush, a rubber.
E.
आङ् before घृष to rub, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rubbed.
E.
आङ् before घृष, क्त aff.

m. (-टः)
1 A limit, a boundary.
2 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.)
E.
आङ्, घट to endeavour, घञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 Killing, striking.
2 A blow, a wound.
3 A slaughter-house, a place for killing animals or victims.
E.
आङ्, हन to kill or injure, in the participial form; घ is substituted for ह.

n. (-नं)
1 Striking, killing.
2 A slaughter-house.
E.
आहन्, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Ghee or boiled butter.
2 Sprinkling.
3 Sprinkling ghee at certain sacrifices.
E.
आङ्, घृ to sprinkle, घञ् aff.
